title: When composition-preserving controls answer the wrong question
hypotheses: Independent uniform and composition-biased sequences will usually be compatible with within-record permutation controls; uniform-background expected counts can mislead on biased sequences.
Locally persistent sequences can appear enriched for homopolymers under mononucleotide controls despite having no planted functional motifs.
A periodically planted exact motif in independent sequence will be more frequent than in shuffled controls.
seed_rule: generator_seed_base + regime_index*100 + repetition; control master seed = generator seed + 1000000

generator.independent: Python Random.choices A,C,G,T equal weights, independently for each position
generator.composition_biased: record 0 weights A=.7 C=.1 G=.1 T=.1; record 1 A=.1 C=.7 G=.1 T=.1; positions independent
generator.locally_structured: start with uniform base; each next position repeats previous with probability .9, otherwise chooses uniformly from the other three; no planting
generator.planted: independent uniform bases then overwrite ACGTAC at starts 16+80*j for j=0..11 in each record; retain input and planted coordinates

null_model: independent Fisher-Yates permutation of concrete bases within each record, ambiguous-base positions fixed
statistics: pooled strand-occurrence counts; every shuffled count; control mean; observed-minus-mean; observed/mean (null if mean=0); upper-tail p=(1+number controls >= observed)/(B+1)
baseline: expected strand-occurrence counts for an independent uniform DNA generator: sum over motif orientations of (valid windows)*(product of IUPAC set sizes)/4^motif_length; palindromes counted once
multiplicity: Holm across four prespecified motifs per dataset, alpha=.05. Fractions of rejections across repetitions are descriptive, not biological discovery claims. Also show Holm across all 128 tests; resolution .005 precludes study-wide .05 rejection. No adaptive motif selection or extra shuffles.
interpretation: Synthetic-only software and null-model diagnostic. No biological function, binding, regulatory activity, Evo2 inference, or experimental validation. Report all results including null outcomes; no rerun or seed selection based on results.
preserve: protocol and runner hash frozen before evaluation
